# MB Center

> MB Center is an independent service center in Sofia, Bulgaria, specialized exclusively in Mercedes-Benz: maintenance, Xentry/Star diagnostics, repairs, SCN online coding and feature activation, transmission service and EQ electric-vehicle service. Work follows Mercedes-Benz WIS (Workshop Information System) procedures and uses OEM parts.

- Address: ул. Райовец 16 (16 Rayovets St.), 1151 Sofia, Bulgaria
- Phone / Viber: +359 883 788 873
- Email: contact@mbcenter.bg
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:30–18:00; Saturday and Sunday closed
- Languages: Bulgarian, English
- Customers: private owners and business fleets
- Booking: online, by phone, Viber or email — https://mbcenter.bg/en/booking/

## Services

- [Periodic maintenance](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): oil and filters, spark plugs, fluids, brakes, A/C, seasonal checks; based on the dashboard service code and mileage, per Mercedes-Benz WIS. Entries recorded in the official Digital Service Booklet (DSB).
- [Xentry Star diagnostics](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): full system scan, live data, fault codes, service history verification. XENTRY Remote Diagnosis for telematics-equipped models (mostly 2020+ with Mercedes me).
- [SCN online coding and programming](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): direct connection to Mercedes-Benz servers; module coding, software updates, feature activation (AMG/Maybach cluster graphics, CarPlay/Android Auto, Digital Light animations, drive modes, assist systems) for W206, S223, EQS, EQE, GLC X254, MBUX 2018+ models, W213, C257, W463, W205 and more.
- [Transmission service](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): 7G-Tronic, 9G-Tronic, 7G-DCT and 8G-DCT oil and filter service, control unit (plate) replacement, programming and adaptation, ISM/DSM selector programming.
- [Repairs](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): AIRMATIC and suspension, steering, brakes/ABS/ESP, ECU and electrical faults, partial engine work (gaskets, fuel system, EGR/DPF, cooling, wiring, chain drive/variator gears), mechatronic and hydraulic block repair, OEM windshield replacement.
- [EQ / electric vehicles](https://mbcenter.bg/en/services/): high-voltage system diagnostics, battery health report, electric drivetrain and charging system repair.
- [Pre-purchase inspection](https://mbcenter.bg/en/about/): condition, history (DSB) and technical check of a Mercedes-Benz before you buy it.
- OEM parts and accessories: genuine Mercedes-Benz parts supplied and fitted.

## Not offered

- Body work: panel beating, dent removal, painting
- Complete engine overhauls (engine opening, timing chain replacement)
- Complete transmission rebuilds

## На български

MB Center е независим специализиран сервиз за Mercedes-Benz в София: обслужване, Xentry Star диагностика, ремонт, SCN онлайн кодиране, скоростни кутии и електромобили EQ. Адрес: ул. Райовец 16, 1151 София. Тел./Viber: +359 883 788 873. Работно време: понеделник–петък 9:30–18:00.
